crosswalks.historical_boundary: Approximately 1,100 km2 traditional Jenne hinterland survey region; population interval applies only to Jenne-jeno and satellites within approximately 1 km, not to all 1,100 km2.
crosswalks.boundary_confidence: medium for 1,100 km2 survey; low for urban cluster to rural capacity equivalence
crosswalks.resolution_method: Use the dedicated djenne location as an explicit containing selector and cap the mapped area at the published 1,100 km2 survey region. Do not assign the urban 1-km population interval to the entire EU5 footprint and do not use it in training aggregates.
crosswalks.notes: The 88.8% unmapped area is intentional and blocks any interpretation as an exact EU5 aggregate. This crosswalk is a held-out physical/archaeological validation case only.
